criteria_description: Revenue generated from wind, solar, hydro, and geothermal energy operations.
Revenue derived from healthcare services, medical devices, and hospital operations.
Revenue from clinical trials, pharmaceutical R&D, and biotechnology research.
Revenue derived from oil, gas, and thermal coal extraction or power generation.
Revenue from cultivation, production, or distribution of tobacco and nicotine products.
Revenue generated from casinos, lotteries, and online betting operations.
Revenue derived from military contracting, weapons systems, firearms, and ammunition production.
Revenue generated from production, distribution, or broadcasting of adult entertainment media.
Revenue derived from nuclear power generation, uranium mining, and nuclear reactor manufacturing.
Revenue derived from the brewing, distilling, distribution, and wholesale of alcoholic beverages.
Revenue generated from smart grids, battery storage, LED lighting, and energy-efficient systems.
Revenue derived from water purification, wastewater treatment, desalination, and recycling technology.
Revenue from municipal and industrial recycling, composting, and resource recovery operations.
Revenue from certified organic farming, sustainable forestry, and regenerative agricultural practices.
Revenue derived from eco-certified construction materials, green building design, and retrofitting.
Revenue from the development, construction, ownership, management and provision of affordable housing and social housing.
Revenue from educational institutions, vocational training, professional education and educational services.
